concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-local-payment-methods]] - regional bank, wallet and other local-method scope; eligible-merchant and PayPal-account prerequisites; locality-based display; euro presentment and primary-currency PayPal settlement; redirect-qualified Payment Context visibility; and unsupported dispute, vaulting and recurring-transaction boundaries
warnings: Treat the 2026-09-16 page as collected snapshot evidence, not confirmation of current merchant enablement, method support or customer eligibility.
Keep customer availability qualified by the exact Local Payment Method and locality; do not generalize iDEAL or Bancontact examples to other methods or countries.
Preserve the page's most-methods redirect modality and do not describe Payment Contexts as transaction, settlement or funding proof.
Do not import behavior from unread linked developer documentation or from PayPal APM sources into this Braintree guide.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-local-payment-methods]] - Braintree guide stating that vaulting payment methods and creating recurring transactions are currently unsupported for Local Payment Methods
warnings: Keep this limitation scoped to Braintree Local Payment Methods and the collected guide; do not generalize it to PayPal, ACH, cards or other payment-method products.
The page's current-tense statement is snapshot evidence, not confirmation of present support or roadmap.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-local-payment-methods]] - Braintree guide stating that disputes are currently unsupported for Local Payment Methods and customers must work directly with their bank
warnings: Keep this statement scoped to Braintree Local Payment Methods; do not apply it to Braintree card, ACH, PayPal, Venmo or other dispute flows.
Do not infer a bank dispute lifecycle or merchant remedy from this page; it only directs customers to work with their bank.
